definitions.full: H1910. Hadadrimmon הֲדַדְרִמּוֺן proper name, of a divinity (or proper name, of a location derived from n.pr.divin ), Hadadrimmon (= n.pr.divin. Hadad (compare above) + n.pr.divin. Rimmon, Rammôn , see רִמּוֺן ; compare COT Zech 12:11 Dl ZK 1885, 175 & on question of name of a location or a divinity Brd Zc Baud stud. i. 293 f. Hi-St Zc Ri HWB RS Semitic i. 392 ) — in simile of mourning in Jerusalem מְגִדּוֺן כְּבִקְעַת הֲדַדְרִמּוֺן כְּמִסְמַּד 12:11 ; on ׳ה for ההרמונה Amos 4:3 , see הרמון ; & compare Hi-St Gunning.
